A couple of security / compliance notes before execution:
- Confirm there are no active eDiscovery or legal holds tied to FT-2391. I queried our governance DB and found no holds as of 2027-04-20, but the customer should confirm.
- Backups: Our backup retention pipeline (cold snapshots) retains index-level snapshots for 30 days. Deletion job will mark records as removed and also emit a purge marker to prevent restore. We cannot retroactively remove snapshots that were already exported to third-party backup storage; if FinTechCorp had offsite archive requests, we need to handle those separately.
- Scope clarity: prompts = user-supplied input text held in prompt_store; outputs = model_response bucket and generation logs; request/response logs = api_audit indices. KV cache is ephemeral but our runtime writes minimal cache traces to diagnostic logs; Monica’s manifest step must include those keys.

I’ll perform post-deletion verification and sign the proof once sampling passes. Also attaching a pointer to Jira ticket INF-8721 for our internal audit steps.
